name: tempovision
description: Directs and produces lyric music videos from your song: interviews you, sets up tools, maps the song, writes the treatment, sources assets, builds, self-reviews and delivers.

fal_key.title: fal API key (optional)
fal_key.description: Enables image, video and upscaling models through the fal MCP server. Only needed for generated imagery or footage. Get one at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys

pexels_api_key.title: Pexels API key (optional)
pexels_api_key.description: Free key for searching stock footage and photos through the Pexels MCP server. Get one at https://www.pexels.com/api/

pixabay_api_key.title: Pixabay API key (optional)
pixabay_api_key.description: Free key for searching Pixabay stock footage and photos (an alternative to Pexels). Log in at https://pixabay.com/api/docs/ and copy the key shown there. Takes effect in the next session.

projects_root.title: Projects folder
projects_root.description: Where new music video projects are created. Leave empty to create them in the current folder.

default_engine.title: Default render engine
default_engine.description: HyperFrames (HTML + GSAP) or Remotion (React). The intake interview can still change it per project.
